newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes slightly higher, mkt quiet.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes slightly higher, mkt quiet.

text.p: The Prague Stock Exchange continued to stagnate on Thursday with the PX50 index edging slightly higher and turnover staying well below 400 million crowns.
The PX50 closed up 0.19 percent to 538.3 while the RPIX index of continuously traded shares rose 0.37 percent to 1,125.
Among the major issues, Komercni Banka rose 10 crowns to 2,230, CEZ edged one crown higher to 1,005, SPT Telecom gained 20 crowns to 3,370 and Ceska Sporitelna rose six crowns to 319.
Despite the gains, dealers cautioned that turnover was extremely low and that activity was unlikely to pick up until fresh factors were introduced into the market.
On Thursday, the central bank said it had left interest rates unchanged at its regular board meeting.
